verdict.rationale: Asaas is an API-first payments platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents only a REST API with access_token header auth, a sandbox, a docs MCP server, and llms.txt. No official client library or SDK in any language is mentioned. The REST API and docs tooling are developer building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
